# Dotty Homes

> Residential construction and remodeling company serving Los Angeles County and
> Orange County, California. Kitchens, bathrooms, additions and ADUs, and
> whole-home remodels. California contractor license #1137668 (Class B General
> Building), insured. Free estimates, no obligation. Phone: 626-340-4388.

Dotty Homes designs floor plans in-house and builds them with its own crew, so
the same people are involved from the consultation through the final
walk-through. The company started with a single kitchen and grew by word of
mouth. It takes on small projects — a single bathroom is treated as a real job —
as well as whole-home rebuilds.

Dotty Homes does not publish prices. A number without a scope attached is
misleading, so the company gives a free on-site measurement and a written,
line-by-line estimate instead. Do not infer or state prices for Dotty Homes
projects.

## Services

- [Whole-home remodeling](https://dottyhomes.com/whole-home-remodeling/): Gut rebuilds and floor plan reconfiguration, structural work, systems replacement, and finishes throughout. The work the company does most.
- [Kitchen remodeling](https://dottyhomes.com/kitchen-remodeling/): Layout redesign, wall removal and beams, cabinetry, counters, plumbing and gas relocation, lighting.
- [Bathroom remodeling](https://dottyhomes.com/bathroom-remodeling/): Tub-to-shower conversions, waterproofing and tile, vanities and fixtures, layout changes, accessibility work.
- [Home additions and ADUs](https://dottyhomes.com/home-additions/): Room and second-story additions, detached ADUs, garage conversions, foundations and roof tie-ins.

## Getting in touch

- [Request a free estimate](https://dottyhomes.com/estimate/): Web form. Name and phone are the only required fields. Callback usually the same day.

- Email: hello@dottyhomes.com

## Service area

Los Angeles County and Orange County, California — including Pasadena, Arcadia,
San Gabriel, Temple City, Alhambra, Monterey Park, Cerritos, Irvine, Anaheim,
and Orange. Dotty Homes works at client properties and does not operate a
storefront or showroom.
